structured.rankingRationale: Top-ranked opportunities combine a verified future date with either explicit participant-arranged accommodation (OENOVITI), a local Nyon venue (GDPM), direct MICE buyer access (SET’UP/INTER[action]) or strong airport-corridor fit. citations.title: Announced for 20–21 January 2027 at Palexpo Geneva Hall 4, bringing venues, hotels, destinations, DMCs and corporate decision-makers together.
Event listing states 23–25 February 2027 in Geneva and describes networking, group interactions and partner showcase for the EMEA meetings-and-events community.
Official press kit confirms 5–11 April 2027, professional days followed by public weekend, expanding from Palexpo into the city centre.
SETAC official page confirms 25–29 April 2027 in Geneva at Palexpo, next to Geneva Airport.
Palexpo listing confirms 11–14 May 2027 at Palexpo Hall 2 and identifies GEMEXPO SA as organizer; official practical page says professionals and buyers attend.
Organizer page confirms 19–21 May 2027 in Nyon, hosted by Changins and Agroscope; members must make their own accommodation bookings and a nearby hotel is recommended.
ITC announcement confirms 25–27 May 2027 in Geneva and expected participation of more than 1,000, including ministers, officials, business and institutional leaders.
EPHJ official exhibitor page confirms Palexpo and 8–11 June 2027, with exhibitors from watchmaking, jewellery, microtechnology, medtech and related sectors.
Official summit page confirms 21–22 June 2027 at Palexpo and says it runs back-to-back with AI for Good, including exhibition and curated activities.
ITU official page confirms 21–24 June 2027 at Palexpo, with 800+ speakers, 300+ exhibitors, 170+ countries and 50+ UN agencies.
Palexpo announcement confirms IAS 2027 at Palexpo 11–15 July 2027 and nearly 5,000 participants from more than 130 countries; IAS site also identifies the paired HIVR4P event 10–12 July.
Agroscope confirms the scientific meeting in Nyon from 13–16 July 2027.
UNIGE page confirms 6–8 September 2027, jointly organized by EPFL and UNIGE and hosted by the University of Geneva.
SLAS official calendar confirms 16–18 May 2028 in Geneva, Switzerland.
Geneva Convention Bureau press release confirms Geneva as host city for Velo-city 2028 on 13–16 June 2028, focused on cycling planning and promotion.
